'''Jilam Kester's base''' was the hideout of [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] [[Jilam Kester]]. It was located in the city of [[Chelpori]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Celen]].<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

Shortly after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Kester took refuge in his hideout and assisted in the efforts of hiding [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] hunters. Kester's activities did not go unnoticed, as [[Squad 40]], an [[Imperial commando/Legends|Imperial commando]] squad from the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], was tasked to capture him. When Squad 40 stormed Kester's hideout, they were surprised when they came face to face with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Iri Camas]] instead. Camas distracted the commandos long enough to allow Kester to escape. In the end, Camas sacrificed himself by igniting a gas pipe and destroying the hideout in the subsequent explosion.<ref name="IC 501st" />
